user.title: Connect to AlphaESS Portal
user.description: Sign in with your current AlphaESS customer portal account. The wallbox serial number is optional and can be added later through Reconfigure if it is not detected automatically.

reconfigure.title: Assign wallbox
reconfigure.description: Enter the wallbox serial number. It starts with ALP.

error.session_rejected: The login succeeded, but the portal has not released the new session yet.
error.system_access_denied: The login succeeded, but the portal is still denying access to this system.
error.cannot_connect: The AlphaESS portal is currently unavailable.
error.portal_status: The AlphaESS portal returned status {status} during {step}.

init.title: Update interval
init.description: Whole seconds from 5 to 300 are allowed. Short intervals cause correspondingly frequent cloud requests and may be rate limited. Defaults: G1T 120 seconds, G2T 30 seconds.
